senses.gloss: (= יוֹסֵי, Frank. Meb. Y. s. v.) pr. n. m. Assi;
an Amora, mate of R. Immi, disciple of Rab and of Samuel.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:10:4">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 45ᵃ</cite> bot. <cite ref="T00127"><he>רבסי</he></cite> = <he>רב א׳</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:3:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כגון אילין ספרוי דא׳ וכ׳</he> as for instance, if witnesses say, these are the books written by Assi, and like these (in handwriting) must the documents be.
